title: etching host profile (machine-readable part)
description: Schema for .etching/profile.json. v1 is deliberately minimal: only keys the CLI actually branches on. Unknown keys are rejected (fail-closed). Agent-facing conventions live in .etching/profile.md, which the CLI never parses.

version.description: Profile format version. A new key set that changes CLI behaviour bumps this.

proposal_mode.description: When true, the CLI never replaces the source .drawio and never moves the current pointer; it writes <name>.agent-proposal.drawio plus a generation. See contracts/delivery.md section 3.
